title: Splintermoor's Doubling Reeds
story: In the Whisper Marsh, every reedling Mr 6 swats splits into two new reedlings — so hitting them is the worst idea in the swamp. The brood starts as 7 reedlings, and Mr 6 counts that the swarm doubles once every hour on its own, whether he swings or not. His singing-frog allies can calm exactly 60 reedlings per hour, and he needs to know how big the brood will be after 4 hours so he can call in enough frogs.
question: Starting from 7 reedlings and doubling every hour, how many reedlings will there be after 4 hours?
praise: Doubling repeatedly was exactly right — it just needed one more doubling to reach the fourth hour.
hint: Write the count for each hour in a row and double as you go — count the doublings, not the numbers.
victory: Mr 6 hires two frog choirs instead of one, and 112 reedlings doze off mid-wiggle; Splintermoor becomes the marsh's softest lullaby.
imagePrompt: A swirling brood of glowing reed-sprites multiplying above misty swamp water at dusk, while a small knight numeral 6 holds up a counting tally beside singing frogs.
